segments.speaker: DFA Secretary Ma. Theresa P. Lazaro
segments.text: Today's briefing is an opportunity to provide you with an overview of DFA and its attached agencies' key accomplishments, priorities, and proposed fiscal year 2027.

segments.speaker: DFA Secretary Ma. Theresa P. Lazaro
segments.text: The work of the department continues to be anchored into the three pillars of Philippine foreign policy, preservation and enhancement of national security, promotion and attainment of economic security, and the protection of the rights and promotion of the welfare and interests of Filipinos overseas.

segments.speaker: DFA Secretary Ma. Theresa P. Lazaro
segments.text: These pillars give our diplomatic engagements, our work in advancing the country's economic interests, and our delivery of consular services.

segments.speaker: DFA Secretary Ma. Theresa P. Lazaro
segments.text: And assistance to national services to overseas Filipinos around the world.

segments.speaker: DFA Secretary Ma. Theresa P. Lazaro
segments.text: For fiscal year 2027, the department is seeking a total budget of approximately 35,173,000,000 pesos, which will enable us to sustain our core operations and respond to the Philippines' growing requirements in national security, economic diplomacy, consular services,

segments.speaker: DFA Secretary Ma. Theresa P. Lazaro
segments.text: assistance to nationals and organizational development.
